checks.name: Missing file keeps a directory-check action instead of unknown failure
Persistent busy read shows the real category and exhausted attempts
Unknown write effect after timeout tells teacher to check and not repeat, without claiming the write was stopped
Permission failure is shown as unauthorized with one attempt, never successful retry
Bounded pending second read is shown as preparation, never already completed
Legacy history without attempt adds no invented count or unknown effect
Private or forged-success attempt summary is rejected by existing component contract
Queued reads display waiting, with no fake teacher decision or completed work
Completed reads expose independent queue/execution timing; legacy records invent neither

scope: SSR safety/presentation contract only; not visual runtime or provider
